/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 小新台湾 (Crayon Shin-chan TW) CBT 测试首周报告
模块编号 : 01 - 核心 KPI 与留存/活跃对比 (TW CBT vs SG CBT/OBT vs SD TC)
数据表   : 
  - 小新繁体 CBT: ta.v_event_18 (AppID 18)
  - 小新新加坡  : ta.v_event_13 (AppID 13)
  - 灌篮高手繁体: ta.v_event_21 (AppID 21)
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),
UserBlacklist13 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
UserBlacklist18 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SingaporeUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),

-- 1. 小新繁体 CBT 每日 KPI
ShinchanTW_KPI AS (
    SELECT
        '小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        e."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'new_role' THEN e."#user_id" END) AS new_roles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'login' THEN e."#user_id" END) AS dau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN e."$part_event" = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN e."#user_id"
        END) AS payers,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN e."$part_event" = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(s5.exchange, 1)
        END), 0.0) AS revenue
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange s5
      ON e."$part_date" = s5.ex_date
     AND e.pay_currency = s5.currency
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist18 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

-- 2. 新加坡 CBT / OBT1 参照系 (AppID 13)
ShinchanSG_KPI AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14' THEN '小新新加坡OBT1'
        END AS cohort_name,
        e."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'new_role' THEN e."#user_id" END) AS new_roles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'login' THEN e."#user_id" END) AS dau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN e."$part_event" = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN e."#user_id"
        END) AS payers,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN e."$part_event" = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
        END), 0.0) AS revenue
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    INNER JOIN SingaporeUsers su ON e."#user_id" = su.user_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist13 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

-- 3. 灌篮繁体 参照系 (AppID 21)
SlamDunkTC_KPI AS (
    SELECT
        '灌篮繁体基准' AS cohort_name,
        e."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'NUU' THEN e."#account_id" END) AS new_roles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") AS dau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'PURCHASE' THEN e."#account_id" END) AS payers,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'PURCHASE' THEN TRY_CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.amount') AS DOUBLE) END), 0.0) AS revenue
    FROM ta.v_event_21 e
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

CombinedKPI AS (
    SELECT * FROM ShinchanTW_KPI
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ShinchanSG_KPI
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SlamDunkTC_KPI
)

SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比项目/大区",
    stat_date AS "日期",
    new_roles AS "新增角色数",
    dau AS "日活跃人数(DAU)",
    payers AS "付费人数",
    ROUND(payers * 100.0 / NULLIF(dau, 0), 2) AS "渗透率/付费率(%)",
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS "总流水($)",
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(dau, 0), 2) AS "ARPU($)",
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(payers, 0), 2) AS "ARPPU($)"
FROM CombinedKPI
ORDER BY "对比项目/大区", "日期"
